verdict.rationale: A direct probe for openapi.json/swagger.json/api/openapi.json/.well-known/openapi.json all returned 404, and no documentation page offers a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec — only human-readable API reference pages and an llms.txt markdown index (not a machine-readable API schema). No evidence of any equivalent spec format (e.g., Postman collection, RAML) is present either.
